mostWorthwhile.text: Making red blood cells was most worthwhile: the marrow inset shows their maturation, and the explanation connects haemoglobin to oxygen delivery.

leastWorthwhile.text: The plasma and nutrient combinations felt repetitive because their pictures added little explanation of how transport works.

surprise.text: The red-cell result showed that developing cells make haemoglobin and lose their nuclei as they mature.

arbitrary.text: Grouping platelets with clotting proteins felt somewhat mechanical: the result named the components but did not explain how they work together.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how blood supplies the responsive arm, although I would hope for more explanations of how the components work.
